edits.before: Q off minions to chip the duo — the angles are the lane and every wave drops souls.
edits.after: Q outranges her Hymn of Valor poke; step up before Power Chord empowers an auto.

edits.before: Soul discipline begins: collect what's safe; the range grows forever.
edits.after: Power Chord procs every third hit — trade in bursts, not extended stand-offs.

edits.before: W threats open: any clumped trade risks the spreading root.
edits.after: Aria's shield-heal starts answering your poke, keeping trades close.

edits.before: Chip the ledger and bank the souls — the collection out-scales every support item.
edits.after: Your range and root punish her lack of engage before Crescendo comes online.

edits.before: Dawning Shadow online — the global beam saves dives and finishes recalls.
edits.after: Crescendo's 900-range stun threatens any all-in her jungler can follow.

edits.before: First item: the Q chunks and the soul thresholds start mocking trade math.
edits.after: Her Aria heal sustains through chip damage until you land anti-heal.

edits.before: Late Senna out-ranges the game from the support slot — souls, beams, and mist.
edits.after: Stacked crit and global R outrange her kit; poke from beyond Crescendo's reach.

edits.before: - Sona Crescendo: matchup-defining — The stun chord flips grouped fights — spread while it is up. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Curse of the Black Mist banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: Crescendo (R) is 140/120/100s — bait it before committing. Hymn of Valor (Q) applies on-hit, so armor alone underrates her poke; Power Chord (P) empowers her third auto for the real damage.

edits.before: A sustain mirror your souls out-scale — chip the angles and let the collection decide the second half.
edits.after: She pokes on-hit and stuns from range — outrange Hymn of Valor, respect Power Chord's third auto, and answer Aria's heal with anti-heal.

edits.before: Out-collect the mirror — infinity wins sustain wars. Crescendo is the 2v2’s metronome — read it before stepping up.
edits.after: Poke before Power Chord procs, and stay outside Crescendo's 900 range once she hits 6.

edits.before: Sona wins by landing Crescendo, denying your pattern, and healing through your math until your windows expire.
edits.after: Sona wins by landing Crescendo, healing off your poke with Aria of Perseverance, and stacking Power Chord damage in extended trades.

edits.before: - Senna vs Sona - Track: Sona Crescendo. - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - Crescendo spent means windows open. - Keep the ult for the swing moment.
edits.after: - Senna vs Sona - Track: Power Chord (P) stacks — the 3rd auto is the real damage. - Hymn of Valor applies on-hit; armor undersells it. - Crescendo's 900 range stuns from far — ward for her jungler. - Anti-heal answers Aria of Perseverance.
